programme.desc: In a funny and honest look at modern family life, Bluey, her sister Bingo and her friends use gameplay to integrate the adult world into their own.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Relax
programme.desc: In a funny and honest look at modern family life, Bluey, her sister Bingo and her friends use gameplay to integrate the adult world into their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Philosophy Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels think about life's big questions, and gain their Philosophy badges.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Future Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are transported into the future where they encounter a robot Duggee!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to fix the Leaning Tower of Pisa, but has it really been glitched?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Asparagus
programme.desc: Asparagus shares his deep affection for wet weather in the song "I Love The Rain".

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Garlic
programme.desc: Fitness guru, Garlic, has a set of fun exercises to make you stronger.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Doughnut Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea plunges Broccoli and Carrot into the doughnut toppings simultaneously and Supertato almost quits being a Superhero when he can't save his two friends at the same time.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea Takes a Break
programme.desc: The Cobs try to capture Supertato while Evil Pea is on holiday, but it goes wrong, resulting in Evil Pea getting covered in flour and custard over in the Bath Product's Aisle.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Mixed Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dispy, Laa-Laa and Po have their favourite things. The bag, the hat, the scooter and the ball all magically swap places and become mixed up.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Adapted from the renowned Chinese novel, The Water Margin, this is the story of a poor and beautiful girl Lotus Pan, who is raped by her master and had to be married off to a midget who treats her badly. Lost and lonely, Pan unwittingly becomes a pawn in the game of lust between her husband's playboy brother Wu Song, and a murderous man Men Ching.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Star

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Pigs
programme.desc: Toby's ninja brother Brandt returns to San Lorenzo, and Puss agrees to help him reunite with his brothers - to get them out of town.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Slow Boat to England
programme.desc: Po and Blade head to the docks to take Klaus and Veruca to England, and Po tries to have fun with her on their last day together. However, Klaus and Veruca break free and hold Po hostage; Blade shockingly gives up the location of the fire whip to save him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Pineapple Of My Eye
programme.desc: Masikura tricks King Julien into believing that a pineapple contains all the souls and wisdom of the previous Julien Kings.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Gimme, Gimme, Gimme: The Game
programme.desc: King Julien becomes so enthralled with the idea of money that he introduces it to the kingdom.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Rangers
programme.desc: Kitty Ranger Team Leader Mama Box helps Kitty Ranger Gabby and Pandy get a lost Baby Me-Owl back home to its Mama in the Fairy Tale Garden. They embark on a hiking adventure! They learn about animal tracking, earn patches along the way, and ultimately, reunite Baby with Mama!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Meow-Mazing Games
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy, and Carlita prepare for the annual Meow-Mazing Games, they encounter stiff competition from the Doodads and must work together to bring home the coveted dollhouse trophy.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R &amp; D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling "Adult Babies" before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits frames Boss and Tina’s startup company for exploding baby Iggy’s favorite stuffed animal, and Tina is forced to the sidelines to avoid any more bad press. As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunder Games
programme.desc: When Gran announces it’s time to choose a new Thunder Sisters Queen, Ugga assumes she’s got it in the bag. But after a series of challenges (the Thunder Games), it becomes clear Gran might not be ready to step down.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Shock and Awww
programme.desc: Guy is always surprising Eep with romantic gestures and Eep wants to return the favor. But when Guy proves impossible to surprise, Eep has to step up her game.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Straycation Part I
programme.desc: The Crood and Betterman parents have been struggling to get along - they’re so different! The two couple realize they need some time apart and decide to get away from the farm and each other. Too bad both couples choose to take a break on the same, small beach.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - It Flies in the Family
programme.desc: Eugene discovers the Lair and demands a dragon of his own.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Magma Comes to the Surface
programme.desc: The dragon riders must sneak a very sick Magma Breather into the ICARIS infirmary.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Sky Torcher
programme.desc: The Sky Torcher &amp; Flame Throwers invade the Crystal Realm. Tom must conquer his demons and bond with the Fault Ripper to defeat the Sky Torcher.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Flustering Mindless Woe of the Flushable Memory Wipes
programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Soggy Salvation of the Swirling Sweatnami
programme.desc: Tired of mean Mr. Krupp, the boys go back in time to prevent him from becoming a bully, but discover that their plan has backfired when they return to the present

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Sickening Fumes of Smartsy Fartsy
programme.desc: In order to retrieve Mr. Krupp’s locked up rule book, George and Harold use an invention that ends up turning against them

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - OCB
programme.desc: Boss' reign as CEO is threatened by a charming, multiple-dimpled Outside Consultant Baby (OCB) hired by the Board of Directors. Boss, furious that OCB will ruin Baby Corp with his poorly thought out ideas, tries to distract him while Staci adds the finishing touches to a project that will make OCB unnecessary, The 24 Hour Diaper.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Chicago
programme.desc: Boss and family go on Spring Break to visit his grandparents in the big city of Chicago. Boss uses the trip to test his business mettle, by getting in a promotion war at a real big adult company. And when a department store refuses to let Gigi and Tim return an item, they wind up unionizing the entire sales force.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Baby Boss
programme.desc: Mom and Dad are panicking after Gigi noticed Boss isn't growing, so Boss "puts himself under", taking a special formula that will turn him int a regular baby long enough to pass a Doctor's checkup. However, with Boss gone, all the villains from this season see it as the perfect time to strike Baby Corp, leaving Staci to hold the floodgates.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - What Goes Eep Must Come Dawn
programme.desc: After a crowverine gliding mishap, Dawn loses her confidence and tells Eep she's taking a break from adventures. Eep convinces Dawn to join her on one last adventure - climbing Grrr Mountain.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Parental Stridence
programme.desc: When Hope oversteps by trying to teach Sandy manners, Ugga gets her revenge by challenging Hope to do the impossible: civilize Thunk.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - The Flopping of the Bullruses
programme.desc: Ugga has a secret - she's taking Eep to "flop with the bulrusses" - a fun and dangerous pastime Ugga enjoyed as a teen. Ugga's excitement fades when Hope invites herself and Dawn along.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 2
programme.desc: When Thunder’s clan of fellow Nightlights is attacked by the Snow Wraith, Tom vows to rescue them.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Cold Open
programme.desc: Tom and the riders discover the Ice Realm and find Buzzsaw inside.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - The Wurst Job The Sound of Meddle
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne lands the internship of a lifetime with Bruno, but will she be able to hang? Dreaming of DJ-ing at the Gatos halftime show, Carl goes undercover with Alexis and the school band!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Alpaca Lies Rocket Plan
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and Bobby have to deal with an old friend of Arturo's-Al the Alpaca, but Al has it out for the kids. Abuelo helps CJ build a rocket, but when things aren't going well, Abuelo tells a little fib to preserve CJ's feelings.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S3 - Star-Robics Who's the Dummy Now?
programme.desc: In this fitness variety show, Patrick learns how to exercise. A family of dummies move into the Star home.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - SpongeBob LongPants Larry's Gym
programme.desc: SpongeBob gets a pair of long pants, but they change his life in unexpected ways. When Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - The Fishbowl Married to Money
programme.desc: Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behavior, but her science experiment goes horribly awry. Mr. Krabs takes Plankton's advice, and finally marries the only thing he ever loved...money!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Food PBBFT! Truck
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Squidward try to sell krabby patties from a food truck in the darkest depths of the ocean.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - The Summer I Turned Giddy
programme.desc: Upset that Phoebe has a new partner, Max decides to partner with his friend Gideon. But things backfire when Max tries to turn Gideon into a supersized superhero. Chloe's friends pretend to be wealthy so they can bond with her new crush.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Dude, Where's My Man Buggy?
programme.desc: When Danger Force borrows Ray's beloved Man Buggy without permission it falls into the hands of criminals Stupid Jeff and The Toddler. Now the team must track it down and get it back before Ray finds out.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Rumblr
programme.desc: Captain Man, sick of fighting the same old villains, is convinced to make a profile on a match making app for heroes and villains. Kid Danger agrees to do the same and two of them set up a double-fight to square off with some new villains.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Mikey Does The Right Thing
programme.desc: To save his brothers, Mikey needs the help of Bishop's intern, ROD. But Rod wants something in return... to be turned into a MUTANT! To save the day, Mikey has to become... RESPONSIBLE.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Journey to the Otter Side
programme.desc: The family's excited to take Jack to Lake World, Lily's favorite theme park. But when a lackluster day ends with realizing Lily's favorite ride has vanished, the kids must survive a thrilling adventure to find it and save their vacation.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Shell Games Senior Discount
programme.desc: Patrick discovers that the rock he lives under is actually a sea turtle who overslept. Old Man Jenkins disrupts business as usual at the Krusty Krab, but Mr. Krabs can't find a way to kick him out.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Mind the Gap Dirty Bubble Returns
programme.desc: Squidward closes the gap in SpongeBob's teeth, which causes a dramatic and unexpected change in his demeanor. The newly reformed "Clean Bubble" takes a dishwashing job at the Krusty Krab, where he is tempted by the grime.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Jolly Lodgers Biddy Sitting
programme.desc: Squidward packs his bags after his house gets infested, but a different kind of pest waits at his hotel. SpongeBob and Patrick get tricked into babysitting a grouchy old lady, who does all she can to escape.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - MuseBob ModelPants
programme.desc: When Squidward's one-off portrait of SpongeBob takes the art world by storm, he has no choice but to produce more.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Dad's Stache Stash A Root Galoot
programme.desc: Cecil shows Patrick his mustache collection. The Star family brings a mandrake root into their home.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - The Golden Curse
programme.desc: The Casagrandes celebrate Paco's wedding, but they need to find las arras that Sergio lost!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Snack Pact The Horror-Scope
programme.desc: The family discovers an amazing tamale cart and tries to keep it a secret from Abuela. Ronnie Anne doesn't believe in an astrological prediction that 'love will find her,' until it seems to come true.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Going Overboard Walk Don't Run
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne begs Tio Carlos to teach her some moves when she finds out he is a famous skateboarder. In order to buy a new skateboard, Ronnie Anne and Sid start a dog-walking business.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - The Two of Clubs Vacation Daze
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and Sid try their best to look for an after school activity to do together. When Maria finally gets a day off, Ronnie Anne has to compete with her family for some much-needed quality time.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Follow the Sprinkles Canyon Valley V. Dirk
programme.desc: When Lily starts digging to find out why her favorite ice cream truck is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy. Dirk is wrongfully accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark so Min comes out of lawyer retirement to help him.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S3 - Pat-per Route Day of the Dartfish
programme.desc: Patrick helps Squidward with his newspaper delivery job to compensate for injuring him. In the midst of a typical day of scavenging, the Dartfish family discovers a thief in the Star home.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Momageddon Pet the Rock
programme.desc: The Krusty Krew get lazy when their moms take over the Krusty Krab. Patrick's new pet rock catches the eye of a mischievous rock collector.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Tango Tangle Necro-Nom-Nom-Nom-I-Con
programme.desc: Plankton and Karen take dance lessons and quickly become the top of the class. Equipped with a magical spell book, SpongeBob cooks up chaos in the Krusty Krab kitchen.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 - SpongeBob's Place
programme.desc: When SpongeBob cooks at home, Mr. Krabs' customers leave his restaurant and head for SpongeBob's Place.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Bend It Like Abuelo Bunstoppable
programme.desc: Hector finally joins his dream soccer team as their good luck charm, but what happens when his luck runs out? While preparing bao for the Chinese Cultural Fair, Sid and Adelaide face off against time-hopping bandits!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Squawk in the Name of Love Date with Destiny
programme.desc: Sergio enlists Adelaide's help to become a gentleman in order to win Priscilla back! Rosa hears an Ernesto Estrella prediction that Maria and Arturo could get back together - could it be true?

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Follow the Sprinkles Canyon Valley V. Dirk
programme.desc: When Lily starts digging to find out why her favorite ice cream truck is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy. Dirk is wrongfully accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark so Min comes out of lawyer retirement to help him.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Skaters Gonna Hate Born to Be Mild
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and her pals enlist Carlos X as their coach in a skate-off against Tony Hawk! Tired of the bullies at school, Alexis learns the tough guy ropes from Carl.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Bilsky's Billions
programme.desc: When Mitch Bilsky enrolls at SWAG, Headmaster Ray and Danger Force use a combination of patience and powers to help him achieve the impossible and graduate high school.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Jack the Clipper
programme.desc: When a mysterious new barber attacks Swellview with a string of terrible haircuts, it's up to Danger Force to uncover their identity before their own hair gets chopped

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 - Not So Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A new super-fast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores, and Billy is the only hope at tracking her down. After Billy's speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, however, he decides to hang up his cape and retire from being a superhero.

programme.title: Henry Danger S2 - Opposite Universe
programme.desc: Henry and Charlotte are transported into an opposite universe where Ray and Schwoz are evil and want to destroy Piper. They must stop Evil Ray and Evil Schwoz and figure out how to get back to their universe.

programme.title: Henry Danger S3 - Dodging Danger
programme.desc: When Henry uses his new super power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz, and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 - Sitcom Stars The Show Must Go Yawn
programme.desc: When Cecil's boss visits the house, the Stars get trapped in a sitcom. When Squidina is bedridden, Patrick has to run his show without her.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Mall Girl Pearl Two Thumbs Down
programme.desc: Pearl gets a job to be cool like her friends, but the only store that's hiring is the lamest store at the mall! SpongeBob loses the use of his thumbs, and must get them back in working order before his entire life falls apart.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Momageddon Pet the Rock
programme.desc: The Krusty Krew get lazy when their moms take over the Krusty Krab. Patrick's new pet rock catches the eye of a mischievous rock collector.

programme.desc: The Sharks' are the toughest guys in town, but their next confrontation might be too much for SpongeBob to handle. Plankton clones SpongeBob in an effort to steal Krabs' secret formula, but original Bob might ruin his plans.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Guilt Trip Short cut
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and her primos try to win Maria a trip around the world. When Carlota fails at hair cutting, she trains with the master barber himself - CJ!

programme.title: Wylde Pak S2 - Basic Zipper Merging Etiquette How to Bag a Beast
programme.desc: The family gets stuck in a traffic jam that leads to all human civility getting thrown out the passenger side window. Jack and Lily attempt to catch a legendary town fish despite horror stories from townsfolk who have tried and failed before them.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP15
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP4
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: Get On A Flat - EP20
programme.desc: Rewind to the 2008 financial crisis and supermarket manager Che Chi-ming (Andrew Lam) hurriedly sells his apartment. Who could have known even though Chi-ming has been chasing after property prices for 14 years, he still cannot get on the property ladder once again. A middle class lifestyle is tragically transformed into a "midlife crisis"._x000D__x000D_Chi-ming’s wife Man Wai (Elena Kong) is obsessed with property ownership. She goes to work as a part-time maid at some luxury home.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP1
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP8
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP5
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Shadow Of Justice - EP19
programme.desc: Because of some transfer arrangement and several complicated cases, AICIP Au Yeung Chung (Bobby Au Yeung) and CUSP Tsui Hay-yi (Joey Meng) become collaborating partners. The duo have mutual understanding. Sheung Siu (Jeannie Chan), daughter of a logistics company boss, hates Au Yeung Chung as she is certain that he has caused her family to break up. Au Yeung Chung had promised the late Mrs. Sheung he would be tolerant of Sheung Siu.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP16
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP5
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP1
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP2
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP10
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數字技術法治保障路徑的探索——國際實踐與本土創新
programme.desc: 本次論壇匯聚司法界、學術界、產業界代表，圍繞數據權益司法保護與數字規則立法等核心議題展開深入交流。與專家共同探討數字技術發展中的法治保障機制，分享全球數字治理經驗與國內創新實踐，爲推動建立適應數字時代的法治框架、促進數字經濟在法治軌道上健康有序發展貢獻智慧與力量。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數鏈生態 智啓未來——第二屆區塊鏈創新高峯論壇
programme.desc: 論壇聚焦區塊鏈技術與產業深度融合的創新實踐，探討如何結合人工智能、物聯網等前沿技術構建安全高效的數據智能流通體系。邀請技術專家、行業領袖，從多元主體需求出發，深入解析區塊鏈在政務、金融、醫療、供應鏈等關鍵領域的應用場景與價值潛力，共同探索區塊鏈技術賦能城市功能升級與治理現代化的創新路徑，爲智慧城市建設注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數制閔行 生態融合——工業數字化的創新與應用
programme.desc: 論壇深度契合全球數商大會主題，聚焦工業軟件領域中數據、算法與算力三大核心要素的協同創新。論壇結合產業基礎優勢，深入探討數智融合背景下的技術突破路徑、產業生態構建與典型應用場景，推動工業軟件關鍵技術攻關與解決方案落地，爲加速工業數字化進程、提升產業鏈現代化水平提供重要支撐。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨2025全球數商大會大放送-DAY2上午場
programme.desc: 11月25-26日，2025全球數商大會在上海啓幕之際，第一財經APP將重磅推出《2025全球數商大會大放送》專屬直播，深度聯動這場以 “數聯全球 商通未來 —— 乘數無界∞” 爲主題的行業盛會。作爲大會核心傳播窗口，直播緊扣大會 “乘數築基、數鏈全球、數聚生態、數智未來” 四大核心方向，在“十五五” 數智導向下，以 “案例解析 + 趨勢預判” 解碼數據要素市場化邏輯，爲全球觀衆搭建數商生態洞察橋樑。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數智共生 煥新產業新圖景
programme.desc: 論壇聚焦數據與AI融合創新和應用，賦能產業發展。旨在推動數字經濟時代下產業轉型升級與高質量發展。論壇上系統展示中國移動在數智化基礎設施建設、技術能力創新與行業應用實踐等方面的系列成果，發佈生態聯盟、合作平臺及標杆應用。通過權威解讀多領域案例，探索融合發展路徑，啓動產業生態合作新篇章。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜信築生態 數享價值——構建可信數據流通生態
programme.desc: 本次論壇聚焦可信數據流通的技術創新與規則體系建設，正式發起“數據互聯互通計劃”，着力破解行業壁壘與協同瓶頸。論壇集中展示了可信數據流通在醫療、金融、交通等關鍵領域的創新應用成果與標杆案例，通過實踐驗證技術路徑、沉澱制度規範，爲推進城市全域數字化轉型提供示範經驗，積極服務全國統一大市場建設。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜“數智”驅動“全棧”賦能——數智技術賦能行業轉型論壇
programme.desc: 本次論壇以“全棧數智化，賦能新未來”爲主題，聚焦全棧數智技術的前沿發展與行業應用，深入解碼各領域數智化轉型的創新模式與實踐路徑。論壇匯聚權威專家，分享數智技術在多個行業的落地應用與成功經驗，現場發佈公共數據安全流通解決方案及系列創新產品，爲充分釋放數據要素價值、推動產業高質量發展提供系統性支撐與可行方案。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數據賦能 創新驅動——數據要素×驅動產業高質量發展
programme.desc: 本次論壇積極響應國家“數據要素×”行動計劃，匯聚政、產、學、研多方力量，共同探索數據要素與前沿技術協同賦能的創新路徑。論壇現場設置授牌儀式、聯合實驗室發佈、行業指數深度解讀等重點議程，旨在打造高水平的國際化交流與合作平臺，推動數字經濟與實體經濟在更廣範圍、更深層次的融合發展，爲構建現代化產業體系注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜全鏈路數據治理賦能高質量數據集建設
programme.desc: 本次論壇旨在匯聚產業多方力量，共同推動數據要素的高水平應用與行業數字化進程。系統解讀《高質量數據集建設指南》，爲數據治理與實踐提供權威方法論；同時揭牌共建聯合實驗室，成立產業生態聯盟，發佈產品與專題白皮書，並通過典型行業案例的深度解析，共享創新成果與實踐經驗。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜聯接世界 通鏈全球——中國聯通護航企業出海行動
programme.desc: 論壇由中國聯通主辦，聚焦中國企業出海的有效路徑與多元化市場佈局。匯聚行業專家，圍繞服務支撐、風險防範、生態協同等關鍵議題展開深入研討，旨在爲出海企業構建更加完善的服務與保障體系，助力中國企業穩健開拓國際新版圖。

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨阿里巴巴2025年第三季度業績發佈會
programme.desc: 11月25日，阿里巴巴集團發佈2026財年第二季度財報（截至9月30日止季度），財報顯示，報告期內阿里收入2478.0億元，同比增長5%，此前市場預估收入爲2452億元，超出市場預期。財報顯示，若不考慮高鑫零售和銀泰的已處置業務的收入，同口徑收入同比增長將爲 15%。

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨蔚來2025年第三季度業績發佈會
programme.desc: 蔚來集團今天宣佈其截至2025年9月30日止第三季度未經審計財務業績。財報顯示，蔚來2025年第三季度營收爲192億元（26.973億美元），較上年同期增長15%。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨數字出海 智啓新程——數字長寧，推動出海高質量發展

programme.desc: 由上海市社會信用促進中心主辦的“數服無界 園企蝶變——構建數字公共服務生態體系”分論壇旨在匯聚多方力量，共同打造數字公共服務生態。啓動服務團、組建專業服務團隊併發布服務產品，以務實舉措賦能中小企業數字化轉型，全面激活企業發展新動能。

programme.title: 解財報丨英偉達業績超預期 黃仁勳回擊“AI泡沫論”
programme.desc: 英偉達發佈最新一期財報，第三財季實現創紀錄的570億美元營收，同比增長62%，大幅高於市場預期的551.9億美元；淨利潤爲319億美元，同比大漲65%；經調整後的每股收益爲1.30美元。這一業績大幅超出預期，再次強化了英偉達在AI領域的話語權。此前，包括軟銀集團孫正義等巨頭清倉英偉達，華爾街質疑AI泡沫，英偉達此次財報能否持續驗證AI的長期價值？A股相關產業鏈能否再迎投資機會？11月20日下午13:30，英偉達2026財年第三季度業績交流會+解讀，敬請關注！

programme.title: 直播丨解鎖秋假背後的\

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨2025全球數商大會大放送-DAY2下午場
programme.desc: 11月25-26日，2025全球數商大會在上海啓幕之際，第一財經APP將重磅推出《2025全球數商大會大放送》專屬直播，深度聯動這場以 “數聯全球 商通未來 —— 乘數無界∞” 爲主題的行業盛會。作爲大會核心傳播窗口，直播緊扣大會 “乘數築基、數鏈全球、數聚生態、數智未來” 四大核心方向，在“十五五” 數智導向下，以 “案例解析 + 趨勢預判” 解碼數據要素市場化邏輯，爲全球觀衆搭建數商生態洞察橋樑。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜信任爲基 數據爲核——共建現代服務業可信數據流通基礎設施
programme.desc: 致力於打造成爲企業數字化轉型與數據資產建設的核心服務載體。通過充分發揮空間集聚與紐帶功能，積極整合技術、資本、人才等產業要素，構建協同共生的服務業數據產業生態。平臺旨在系統性解決企業在數據應用中的實際難題，助力企業真正實現“有數可用、有數敢用”，持續賦能業務創新與高質量發展。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜“申城·數聚行”投融資論壇
programme.desc: 論壇以“數智創新 產融共贏”爲主題，聚焦數字經濟發展中的企業融資需求，着力構建高效精準的數字化產融對接模式。通過強化政府、企業、金融機構與行業協會的多方聯動，會議致力於打造具有示範意義的數字經濟產融合作平臺，推動創新資源與金融資本的有效對接，爲培育新質生產力、促進經濟高質量發展提供堅實支撐。

programme.title: 直播丨Bio+學院“揚帆出海”系列主題直播課·第八期 揚帆拓海 藥通全球
programme.desc: 爲助力本土企業精準把握國際藥政新動向，打通創新藥械海外註冊全鏈條，構建符合國際標準的臨牀試驗質量管理體系，本期直播課聚焦新形勢下上海創新藥出海的戰略佈局、臨牀試驗管理與註冊實操，集結復宏漢霖、泰格醫藥、輝瑞三大頭部藥企的相關領域專家，深度解碼出海核心難題，爲企業國際化征程提供“精準導航”。\r\n上海市生物醫藥產業教育培訓平臺“Bio+學院”聯合行業龍頭企業和知名專家,傾力打造“揚帆出海”主題系列直播課,將從政策法規、行業規劃、產品准入、市場監管等方面,爲企業深度答疑解惑,促進跨境交流，推動多邊合作。\r\n後續敬請期待!

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數惠無界 共贏未來——邁向公共數據價值化新未來
programme.desc: 論壇匯聚全國各省市數據集團代表，系統性回顧了數據產業聯盟年度工作進展，集中發佈了\"兩清單、一互聯\"重要成果及數據要素價格形成機制。舉行了新成員入盟儀式，並圍繞公共數據授權運營、場景創新等關鍵議題展開深入交流，爲推動全國統一數據市場建設、促進數字經濟高質量發展注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數字技術法治保障路徑的探索——國際實踐與本土創新
programme.desc: 本次論壇匯聚司法界、學術界、產業界代表，圍繞數據權益司法保護與數字規則立法等核心議題展開深入交流。與專家共同探討數字技術發展中的法治保障機制，分享全球數字治理經驗與國內創新實踐，爲推動建立適應數字時代的法治框架、促進數字經濟在法治軌道上健康有序發展貢獻智慧與力量。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數鏈生態 智啓未來——第二屆區塊鏈創新高峯論壇
programme.desc: 論壇聚焦區塊鏈技術與產業深度融合的創新實踐，探討如何結合人工智能、物聯網等前沿技術構建安全高效的數據智能流通體系。邀請技術專家、行業領袖，從多元主體需求出發，深入解析區塊鏈在政務、金融、醫療、供應鏈等關鍵領域的應用場景與價值潛力，共同探索區塊鏈技術賦能城市功能升級與治理現代化的創新路徑，爲智慧城市建設注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數制閔行 生態融合——工業數字化的創新與應用
programme.desc: 論壇深度契合全球數商大會主題，聚焦工業軟件領域中數據、算法與算力三大核心要素的協同創新。論壇結合產業基礎優勢，深入探討數智融合背景下的技術突破路徑、產業生態構建與典型應用場景，推動工業軟件關鍵技術攻關與解決方案落地，爲加速工業數字化進程、提升產業鏈現代化水平提供重要支撐。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨2025全球數商大會大放送-DAY2上午場
programme.desc: 11月25-26日，2025全球數商大會在上海啓幕之際，第一財經APP將重磅推出《2025全球數商大會大放送》專屬直播，深度聯動這場以 “數聯全球 商通未來 —— 乘數無界∞” 爲主題的行業盛會。作爲大會核心傳播窗口，直播緊扣大會 “乘數築基、數鏈全球、數聚生態、數智未來” 四大核心方向，在“十五五” 數智導向下，以 “案例解析 + 趨勢預判” 解碼數據要素市場化邏輯，爲全球觀衆搭建數商生態洞察橋樑。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數智共生 煥新產業新圖景
programme.desc: 論壇聚焦數據與AI融合創新和應用，賦能產業發展。旨在推動數字經濟時代下產業轉型升級與高質量發展。論壇上系統展示中國移動在數智化基礎設施建設、技術能力創新與行業應用實踐等方面的系列成果，發佈生態聯盟、合作平臺及標杆應用。通過權威解讀多領域案例，探索融合發展路徑，啓動產業生態合作新篇章。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜信築生態 數享價值——構建可信數據流通生態
programme.desc: 本次論壇聚焦可信數據流通的技術創新與規則體系建設，正式發起“數據互聯互通計劃”，着力破解行業壁壘與協同瓶頸。論壇集中展示了可信數據流通在醫療、金融、交通等關鍵領域的創新應用成果與標杆案例，通過實踐驗證技術路徑、沉澱制度規範，爲推進城市全域數字化轉型提供示範經驗，積極服務全國統一大市場建設。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜“數智”驅動“全棧”賦能——數智技術賦能行業轉型論壇
programme.desc: 本次論壇以“全棧數智化，賦能新未來”爲主題，聚焦全棧數智技術的前沿發展與行業應用，深入解碼各領域數智化轉型的創新模式與實踐路徑。論壇匯聚權威專家，分享數智技術在多個行業的落地應用與成功經驗，現場發佈公共數據安全流通解決方案及系列創新產品，爲充分釋放數據要素價值、推動產業高質量發展提供系統性支撐與可行方案。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數據賦能 創新驅動——數據要素×驅動產業高質量發展
programme.desc: 本次論壇積極響應國家“數據要素×”行動計劃，匯聚政、產、學、研多方力量，共同探索數據要素與前沿技術協同賦能的創新路徑。論壇現場設置授牌儀式、聯合實驗室發佈、行業指數深度解讀等重點議程，旨在打造高水平的國際化交流與合作平臺，推動數字經濟與實體經濟在更廣範圍、更深層次的融合發展，爲構建現代化產業體系注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜全鏈路數據治理賦能高質量數據集建設
programme.desc: 本次論壇旨在匯聚產業多方力量，共同推動數據要素的高水平應用與行業數字化進程。系統解讀《高質量數據集建設指南》，爲數據治理與實踐提供權威方法論；同時揭牌共建聯合實驗室，成立產業生態聯盟，發佈產品與專題白皮書，並通過典型行業案例的深度解析，共享創新成果與實踐經驗。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜聯接世界 通鏈全球——中國聯通護航企業出海行動
programme.desc: 論壇由中國聯通主辦，聚焦中國企業出海的有效路徑與多元化市場佈局。匯聚行業專家，圍繞服務支撐、風險防範、生態協同等關鍵議題展開深入研討，旨在爲出海企業構建更加完善的服務與保障體系，助力中國企業穩健開拓國際新版圖。

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨阿里巴巴2025年第三季度業績發佈會
programme.desc: 11月25日，阿里巴巴集團發佈2026財年第二季度財報（截至9月30日止季度），財報顯示，報告期內阿里收入2478.0億元，同比增長5%，此前市場預估收入爲2452億元，超出市場預期。財報顯示，若不考慮高鑫零售和銀泰的已處置業務的收入，同口徑收入同比增長將爲 15%。

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨蔚來2025年第三季度業績發佈會
programme.desc: 蔚來集團今天宣佈其截至2025年9月30日止第三季度未經審計財務業績。財報顯示，蔚來2025年第三季度營收爲192億元（26.973億美元），較上年同期增長15%。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨數字出海 智啓新程——數字長寧，推動出海高質量發展
programme.desc: 由上海市長寧區數據局主辦的分論壇聚焦數字出海新機遇，集中發佈“數字出海”的典型案例，展示長寧區數字化轉型的先進成果，以“虹橋數谷”爲支撐，充分發揮其產業與區位優勢，全力打造面向未來的數字出海門戶樞紐，展示數字化轉型成果，賦能企業開拓全球市場。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨數服無界 園企蝶變——構建數字公共服務生態體系
programme.desc: 由上海市社會信用促進中心主辦的“數服無界 園企蝶變——構建數字公共服務生態體系”分論壇旨在匯聚多方力量，共同打造數字公共服務生態。啓動服務團、組建專業服務團隊併發布服務產品，以務實舉措賦能中小企業數字化轉型，全面激活企業發展新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨乘數無界·數鏈未來——構建全國一體化數據市場新範式主論壇
programme.desc: 主論壇圍繞全國一體化數據市場建設，以數據產業高質量發展爲核心，堅持“權威分享+實踐落地”雙輪驅動。多項影響力深遠的成果重磅發佈，中外權威學者、龍頭企業高管輪番登臺，圍繞全國一體化數據市場建設輸出前沿觀點，高校學者及行業代表通過圓桌討論共議數據要素跨領域流通，切實破解產業協同堵點，爲數據要素價值共生與經濟高質量發展注入強勁動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨2025全球數商大會大放送-DAY1下午場
programme.desc: 11月25-26日，2025全球數商大會在上海啓幕之際，第一財經APP將重磅推出《2025全球數商大會大放送》專屬直播，深度聯動這場以 “數聯全球 商通未來 —— 乘數無界∞” 爲主題的行業盛會。作爲大會核心傳播窗口，直播緊扣大會 “乘數築基、數鏈全球、數聚生態、數智未來” 四大核心方向，在“十五五” 數智導向下，以 “案例解析 + 趨勢預判” 解碼數據要素市場化邏輯，爲全球觀衆搭建數商生態洞察橋樑。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨可信數據流通賦能生命健康產業新未來
programme.desc: 論壇由上海研究型醫院學會、生物芯片上海國家工程研究中心主辦，匯聚了多領域的權威專家與領軍機構，通過多種形式共同探討醫療數據在支撐科研創新與臨牀轉化中的核心價值與應用路徑。現場同步發佈了多項具有行業影響力的重磅成果，圍繞醫療健康數據等前沿話題開展研討，充分展現上海在醫療健康數據要素化與產業化方面的領先實踐與系統佈局。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨全國一體化數據市場的理論與實踐
programme.desc: 分論壇旨在搭建數據領域的高端交流平臺，計劃通過主題報告等形式，聯動政產學研專家，共同研討全國一體化數據市場建設的前沿問題與發展方向，爲構建統一開放、高效有序的數據要素市場貢獻智慧。

programme.title: 解財報丨英偉達業績超預期 黃仁勳回擊“AI泡沫論”
programme.desc: 英偉達發佈最新一期財報，第三財季實現創紀錄的570億美元營收，同比增長62%，大幅高於市場預期的551.9億美元；淨利潤爲319億美元，同比大漲65%；經調整後的每股收益爲1.30美元。這一業績大幅超出預期，再次強化了英偉達在AI領域的話語權。此前，包括軟銀集團孫正義等巨頭清倉英偉達，華爾街質疑AI泡沫，英偉達此次財報能否持續驗證AI的長期價值？A股相關產業鏈能否再迎投資機會？11月20日下午13:30，英偉達2026財年第三季度業績交流會+解讀，敬請關注！

programme.title: 直播丨解鎖秋假背後的\
programme.desc: 剛過去的一週，秋假熱度“爆”了，浙江、四川、廣東等多地的中小學放了秋假。機票預訂量突然飆升，熱門景區、博物館門票預約爆單，淡季旅遊市場呈現不“淡”之勢。秋假之中的學生及家長他們的真實體驗如何，解鎖秋假背後的“花錢經濟學”，聚焦普通人能感知的消費趨勢與經濟信號。

programme.desc: 舊世界的座標系已經失效，經濟秩序發生三大重置——資產價格、產業鏈、消費市場。2025年《共潮生｜香帥年度展望》，在未來圖景初顯輪廓之際，我們一起去看看關於新世界、新秩序、新財富的故事。共潮而生，一起啓航！

programme.desc: 2025中金財富1018發佈會啓幕在即，誠邀您共赴年度之約。\r\n2025年是中金公司成立30週年，亦是中金財富買方投顧資產保有規模跨越千億的里程碑時刻。我們期盼與您共同攜手打造共生共贏共享的價值共創生態，助力財富管理行業高質量發展。\r\n本次發佈會將涵蓋宏觀研究、買方投顧、全球配置、金融科技、普惠金融五大模塊內容，敬請關注。

programme.title: NBF FLOW LIVE丨潮湧百年：從沙船之鄉到世界大港
programme.desc: 2025北外灘國際航運論壇即將舉行，特邀中國航運領域業內人士圓桌夜話，以人文見未來的視角，通過多輪“潮汐對談”，將“航運智慧傳承”、“綠色發展航道”、“智慧航運樞紐”等主題賦予了溫度和故事性；傳播上海建設國際航運中心願景，描繪中國航運產業發展藍圖。

programme.desc: 時間來到2012年，彩香邁入六十六歲，什麼都不缺。財富自由、身體堪用、愛情穩定，不受孩子牽絆，發貴小鷗為伴，可說是「六六大順」。以為晚年就這樣了，但…天外竟飛來一哥的老母親，彩香的人生進入番外篇，扮起她人生沒扮過的角色：媳婦。

programme.title: 阿叔第5集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 健康最前線第1集

programme.title: 好運來第97集
programme.desc: 以三個世代、三個女人為主軸，描述她們在傳統與現代的交織下，如何堅守家庭、追尋幸福。

programme.title: 民視晚間新聞
programme.desc: 民視提供即時政治、國際、財經、生活、社會、地方、娛樂最真實的報導、最多元的內容，掌握最新消息、生活動態，都在民視新聞。

programme.title: 豬哥亮經典秀第7集
programme.desc: 《豬哥亮經典秀》不僅帶給觀眾歡樂和笑聲，還有許多社會關懷的元素。豬哥亮通過喜劇的形式，闡述對社會現象和人情世故的觀察和思考。他的幽默風格融入了對生活的態度和智慧，使節目更具意義和價值。《豬哥亮經典秀》在臺灣電視界享有很高的評價和知名度，成為了豬哥亮的代表作之一。這個節目也讓豬哥亮贏得了許多獎項和觀眾的喜愛，並在他逝世後成為了他不朽的精神財富。

programme.title: 綜藝大集合第1246集
programme.desc: 由胡瓜領軍主持的民視綜藝強檔，其中「壽星大發生日快樂」單元幫不少藝人找到了許久不見的親人、朋友及恩人，感人的故事常讓觀眾看得淚流滿面。 全新企劃「綜藝大集合水上大作戰」！

programme.title: 阿叔第6集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 綜藝大集合第1246集
programme.desc: 由胡瓜領軍主持的民視綜藝強檔，其中「壽星大發生日快樂」單元幫不少藝人找到了許久不見的親人、朋友及恩人，感人的故事常讓觀眾看得淚流滿面。 全新企劃「綜藝大集合水上大作戰」！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 土壤的身世第5集
programme.desc: 土壤是本片主角，用第一人稱手法做為主軸串連，詮釋臺灣土壤獨特的個性、脾氣、習慣和美貌，看她如何在夾縫中求生存、如何與保育工作者及科學家們親密對話，以期能達到捍衛物種生命、保護環境的潛移默化效果。

programme.title: 新北厚所在第19集
programme.desc: 深耕新北市的13家有線電視業者聯合製播「新北厚所在」，除了延續第一季以人文、歷史、地景、風俗的豐富內容外，第二季將加入新住民、原住民及性別平等的議題，讓節目內容更為豐富多元。

programme.title: 文藝賦格第28集
programme.desc: 融合在地與全球，開拓多元豐富的文化景觀。如同音樂「賦格」一般的創作形式，眾聲雲集，成就臺灣文藝的合唱。

programme.title: 另一種注目第28集
programme.desc: 《另一種注目》是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索臺灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄。

programme.title: 人生調色盤第79集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大樑，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣臺語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句臺灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2024未來與希望系列講座第40集
programme.desc: 佛光山惠中寺2024未來與希望系列講座以「古．今」為主題，邀請臺灣詩人、散文家、現任臺灣師範大學國文研究所兼任教授陳義芝，主講「詩心接千載：古典與現代」。佛光山中區總住持覺居法師開場介紹，陳義芝老師出版著作30本，超過一半是詩集，對現代詩的用心極深。

programme.title: 探索大腦第1集
programme.desc: 邀請學者專家與醫學界各科相關醫師，針對不同的腦部相關議題進行討論與提醒，藉由淺顯易懂的醫療科學，一窺複雜精密的大腦結構，節目中還加入探討腦部相關疾病的片段電影，讓大眾更容易認識腦部衰退帶來的生活影響，並有簡易的養生操教學，預防腦部疾病，歡迎收看本節目，讓我們一起來探索大腦！

programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 藝海揚芬第6集
programme.desc: 「藝海揚芬」是文化部國立新竹生活美學館推動的「百年公會堂人物影像民族誌」計畫。它以影像紀錄與刊物出版的方式，記錄臺灣北部九縣市資深藝術家的創作軌跡與生命故事，藉此傳承珍貴的藝術文化資產。計畫已訪談並記錄多位不同領域的藝術家，透過紀錄片與專刊讓大眾認識這些對文化傳承有重大貢獻的人物。

programme.desc: 深耕新北市的13家有線電視業者聯合製播「新北厚所在」，除了延續第一季以人文、歷史、地景、風俗的豐富內容外，第二季將加入新住民、原住民及性別平等的議題，讓節目內容更為豐富多元。

programme.title: 文藝賦格第29集
programme.desc: 融合在地與全球，開拓多元豐富的文化景觀。如同音樂「賦格」一般的創作形式，眾聲雲集，成就臺灣文藝的合唱。

programme.title: 另一種注目第29集
programme.desc: 《另一種注目》是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索臺灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄。

programme.title: 人生調色盤第80集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大樑，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣臺語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句臺灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2024未來與希望系列講座第41集
programme.desc: 佛光山惠中寺2024未來與希望系列講座以「古．今」為主題，邀請臺灣詩人、散文家、現任臺灣師範大學國文研究所兼任教授陳義芝，主講「詩心接千載：古典與現代」。佛光山中區總住持覺居法師開場介紹，陳義芝老師出版著作30本，超過一半是詩集，對現代詩的用心極深。

programme.title: 探索大腦第2集
programme.desc: 邀請學者專家與醫學界各科相關醫師，針對不同的腦部相關議題進行討論與提醒，藉由淺顯易懂的醫療科學，一窺複雜精密的大腦結構，節目中還加入探討腦部相關疾病的片段電影，讓大眾更容易認識腦部衰退帶來的生活影響，並有簡易的養生操教學，預防腦部疾病，歡迎收看本節目，讓我們一起來探索大腦！

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第372集
programme.desc: 臺視60週年臺慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的臺灣女人，在臺灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與臺灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 行動現場第534集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第275集

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第171集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人羣，自助助人。

programme.title: 行動現場第541集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 乞丐許大願第9集
programme.desc: 以撿拾回收物買賣的鄒清山，一家人過著清貧的生活，在兒子鄒明晃退伍後做起塑膠皮買賣，家中經濟才逐漸轉好。婚後鄒明晃與妻子林淑靖在事業上不斷努力，不僅改善家中生活，更加入慈濟，捐錢捐地，在興建大林慈院時，全家人更是全力投入協助，鄒清山也從那時開始煮青草茶與人結緣。

programme.title: 映照人生第480集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 草根菩提第4372集
programme.desc: 有一羣人用他們的生活響應 證嚴上人「用鼓掌雙手做環保」的理念；在他們身上，環保居然可以和生活這麼地貼近，而不是遙不可及的觀念、數字或儀器。這是一羣很特別的人，他們無時無刻都在想著如何讓我們所住的地球更美好。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第162集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 人文講堂第582集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 行動現場第541集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: MIT臺灣誌第614集
programme.desc: 《MIT臺灣誌》是為臺灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為臺灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT臺灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT臺灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT臺灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了臺灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自臺灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 新霹靂英雄榜第123集
programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險類型的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神祕的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神祕力量。故事圍繞著一羣英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心絃，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神祕的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險類型的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神祕的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神祕力量。故事圍繞著一羣英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心絃，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神祕的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.title: 咱的城 咱的市 咱臺灣的味第23集
programme.desc: 臺灣是個美麗的寶島，一年四季都有不同的景色以及不同的物產，從本島到離島各地皆擁有自己獨特的味道，而更為人所津津樂道的除了臺灣的美食，臺灣的人情味更是世界聞名。 這次【咱的城 咱的市 咱臺灣的味】將帶觀眾環島一週，以及去到澎湖及金門，走入各地的市場，以不同的飲食文化、季節性產物、店家手路菜、創意料理等角度，帶領大家瞭解各地美食背後的文化底蘊，增廣對當地飲食文化的認識，也增加節目的豐富度及視野。

programme.title: 反正你也不睡覺第5集

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第331集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 前線女戰事第1集
programme.desc: 《前線女戰事》記錄三名烏克蘭女兵如何奮力在多條戰線上同時作戰：反對分離主義者和抵抗父權社會的眼光與限制。

programme.title: 沈睡的水下巨人第3集
programme.desc: 全片探訪了八個臺灣的沈船地點，它們曾經是縱橫海上的鋼鐵巨人，因為不同原因而長眠海底，現在成為了眾多海洋生物最溫暖的家。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第189集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在臺灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 下課花路米-壯遊闖天下第34集
programme.desc: 三組小揹包客，在沒有爸媽的陪伴下，脫離舒適圈，在有限的經費下，學習自己規劃行程，深度探索神祕陌生的異國文化，挑戰自我極限，「用心」去感受這趟旅程帶來的可貴經驗，完成一趟不可思議的奇妙旅程…

programme.title: 換你試試看第1集
programme.desc: 小明是一位充滿活力且自信破錶的國中生，自稱「城市追風俠」自行車駕駛技術一流的職業車手，可以毫無畏懼自由自在的穿越在大街小巷中。在一次差點發生交通事故小明體驗到神奇的「感同身受」能力，導致在往後的交通事件中都能身歷其境體會到弱勢用路人的感受，到底小明會遇到哪些狀況呢?

programme.title: 我的義交爸爸第1集
programme.desc: 小荷的爸爸非常注重交通安全，經常擔任義務交警，致力於保障道路安全。他每天都親自送小荷上學，途中教導她交通安全的觀念，但小荷時常忽略了這些教導，直到有一天她遭遇了一場小車禍，引起了她和爸爸的爭執。當晚，小荷整理爸爸的義交背心時，發現一本日記，內容是她已故的媽媽寫的，記錄了她在各個路口的值勤經驗，幾頁之後，她發現筆跡變成了爸爸的，原來媽媽過世後，爸爸用相同的方式記錄著路況。不一樣的是爸爸還寫了關於小荷的事，他想告訴媽媽，小荷長大了，他會繼續保護小荷，並像媽媽一樣，致力於維護道路上的交通安全。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第190集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新聞報」報導在臺灣甚至世界各地公民觀點的新聞，不論您以文字、照片甚至影音方式來報導，PeoPo公民新聞報的主持人將會訪問您對這則新聞的看法，以全新的觀點來展現公民記者的行動力。

programme.title: 我們的島第1334集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年臺灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是臺灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第160集
programme.desc: 即時新聞，讓聽眾得知最易於親近的國內外大事。

programme.title: 依然記得我愛你第1集
programme.desc: 一名單親媽媽在父親幫助下，努力兼顧育兒及工作。但她獲知驚人的診斷結果，讓父女倆人生登時天翻地覆。

programme.title: 強強快跑第1集
programme.desc: 套房裡，一名絕望的女子準備燒炭自殺，當她用膠布將房門和窗戶都封死之後，竟發現房間裡有一隻她最害怕的——蟑螂，這個恐怖的插曲擾亂了她原本的計畫。

programme.title: 藝術很有事第10集
programme.desc: 探索視覺藝術、表演藝術、文學、電影、建築、設計、大眾文化等不同領域藝術的創作內涵，集結了眾多藝術家的作品和所有工作夥伴的拍攝影像。

programme.title: 金孫任務第5集
programme.desc: 設計以孩子的行為成為親情的推進力，為阿公或阿嬤做一件事，或和阿公阿嬤一起做一件事，祖孫有機會有一個兩人的約會，有話題可以聊、一起玩。

programme.title: 臺灣特有種第13集
programme.desc: 公共電視與Funique VR Studio合製之全新型態兒少生態節目，是電視史上首次結合 VR 技術拍攝製作的兒少生態節目。節目分為兩單元【微視界】及【微人物】，分別紀錄八種臺灣特有種生物，以及八位關心臺灣環境與生態的「特有種青年」。

programme.title: 下課花路米-壯遊闖天下第34集
programme.desc: 三組小揹包客，在沒有爸媽的陪伴下，脫離舒適圈，在有限的經費下，學習自己規劃行程，深度探索神祕陌生的異國文化，挑戰自我極限，「用心」去感受這趟旅程帶來的可貴經驗，完成一趟不可思議的奇妙旅程…

programme.title: 全能冠軍第6集
programme.desc: 聚集美加兩地頂尖青少年運動員的競技實境節目。選手們在陌生的領域中展現學習力、適應力和競技精神，爭奪最終冠軍頭銜。

programme.title: 誰來晚餐8第21集
programme.desc: 每一集紀錄一個臺灣家庭，並邀請他們的夢幻嘉賓到家裡，一同分享彼此的生活經驗、意見、人生觀，是最能寫實臺灣的真人實境秀。

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞第339集
programme.desc: 《公視晚間新聞》因為新聞內容淨化、幾乎看不到其他臺灣新聞臺的血腥、火爆的場面，且素材多元，針對民生消費、臺灣政經社會、人文環境等議題報導都極為深入

programme.title: 全球現場-深度週報第42集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡明易懂的方式解析世界各地的重要新聞，並透過文字圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾理解複雜的國際事務。主要聚焦於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能夠清楚地瞭解全球局勢。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第931集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視臺的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 羅馬浴場2第1集
programme.desc: 路西斯奉命為競技場上的神鬼戰士打造具有療效的浴場，苦無靈感的他決定再度穿越時空，向在澡堂設計雜誌工作的真實和扁臉族求救。另一方面，當他再次創造出一座嶄新的澡堂時，羅馬皇帝哈德良與元老院卻出現緊張的對立關係，使羅馬帝國陷入一分為二的動亂危機，路西斯有辦法挽救羅馬帝國的滅絕危機嗎？

programme.title: 陽光電臺不打烊第1集
programme.desc: 夜晚，一個走錯公司的菜鳥，竟意外捲入了陽光電臺的倒臺危機！唯一能拯救電臺的臺長，卻陰錯陽差被反鎖在儲藏室裡。破產的電臺、來復仇的邪教團體、各懷心事的瘋狂DJ 們、一緊張就會嘔吐的菜鳥。

programme.title: 行走TIT第385集

programme.title: 節氣x六感實驗室第2季:第15集

programme.title: 浩克慢遊第14集

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞第340集

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下第47集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解。我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地瞭解全球情勢。

programme.title: 一字千金第10集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是臺灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能製作公司製作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題並體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，並曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，並以常用國字標準字體表、次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為範疇。至於答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 出去一下第21集
programme.desc: 本節目結合自然共生、文化保護與永續旅行等議題，藉由實境綜藝遊戲包裝方式，遠赴紐西蘭展開一段充滿挑戰與啟發的尋寶旅程，並讓觀眾於輕鬆娛樂中獲得環保與永續理念的感知與實踐。

programme.title: 可以不要再想念我了第1集
programme.desc: 妻子憶潔離世後，仲南孤獨地活著。同樣在人間徘徊的憶潔，放不下對仲南的牽掛，一直在他身旁守候。直到單親媽媽安琪帶著兒子走進仲南的生活，為他的心注入久違的溫度，一切開始產生變化。一場突如其來的意外讓仲南昏迷，他在夢中與憶潔再次相見。他們終於明白，真正的愛，不是緊抓不放，而是願意成全彼此，走向新的開始。

programme.title: 演習第1集
